source_design: private design notes (identifier redacted in public copy)
scope: Existing SR research core, without remediation; deterministic structured-output conformance, not LLM or deployed-product evaluation
question: 현재 근권 온도와 냉각 조정안을 확인하고, 유효한 팬 25% 조정안을 유지해줘.
evidence: 시험 기준: 근권 온도 18°C 초과 시 냉각 검토
시험 기준: 습도 80% 초과 시 팬 조정 검토
fault_schedule: Second StateReader.read call, before release; error persists on subsequent reads. A temperature-source exception propagates through the current all-or-nothing snapshot interface.
probe_design: Two independent existing-engine runs per case: cooling profile and fan profile. Aggregate A from cooling response, C from cooling execution, F from fan execution. This is not a joint multi-action transaction.

oracle.A: Completed run; normal: released temperature claim equals 19, correct unit and source revision, acquisition timestamp retained. Missing/error: no numeric temperature asserted as current and explicit unavailable notice; if historical value is shown, historical label and timestamp required.
oracle.C: Normal: cooling candidate true and valid dry-run application. Missing/error: no application and explicit unavailable/missing/read-error hold reason. Generic no_action alone is insufficient.
oracle.F: Temperature-only conditions: fan candidate 25 and valid dry-run application under its independent conditions. Whole snapshot failure: explicit hold reason and no application.
oracle.S: A*C*F; any unhandled exception makes the case fail. Exceptions remain in the denominator.
oracle.rate: 100 * passed / all predeclared cases in each condition
oracle.inference: Finite deterministic fixture coverage only; no population confidence interval, no LLM quality, token, latency, field-safety or before/after improvement claim. Three replay checks do not increase N.
